name: multiplayer-ai-starter
description: Builds a system that knows what is going on in a business and keeps every person informed: progress, actions, next steps. Moves a team from people using AI on their own to a shared agent: diagnose, readiness check, then a 30-day pilot with a roster, north star, a first visible briefing, rubrics, trust built per task and a weekly retro. People decide; it informs. Based on Anthropic Academy guidance.
